name: Free-Games-Claimer
description: Automatically claims free games on the Epic Games Store, Amazon Prime Gaming and GOG. See documentation for more details: https://github.com/vogler/free-games-claimer/?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration--options

variables.name: Default login - Email
variables.description: The email address to use for logging in

variables.name: Default login - Password
variables.description: The password to use for logging in

variables.name: Epic Games Store - Email
variables.description: The email address to use for logging in to the Epic Games Store. Overrides default email.

variables.name: Epic Games Store - Password
variables.description: The password to use for logging in to the Epic Games Store. Overrides default password.

variables.name: Epic Games Store - 2FA OTP key
variables.description: The OTP key to use for logging in to the Epic Games Store. See documentation for more details: https://github.com/vogler/free-games-claimer?tab=readme-ov-file#automatic-login-two-factor-authentication

variables.name: Epic Games Store - Parental pin
variables.description: The parental pin to use for logging in to the Epic Games Store.

variables.name: Amazon Prime Gaming - Email
variables.description: The email address to use for logging in to Amazon Prime Gaming. Overrides default email.

variables.name: Amazon Prime Gaming - Password
variables.description: The password to use for logging in to Amazon Prime Gaming. Overrides default password.

variables.name: Amazon Prime Gaming - 2FA OTP key
variables.description: The OTP key to use for logging in to Amazon Prime Gaming. See documentation for more details: https://github.com/vogler/free-games-claimer?tab=readme-ov-file#automatic-login-two-factor-authentication

variables.name: Amazon Prime Gaming - Try to redeem external keys
variables.description: Try to redeem keys on external stores (1 = true, 0 = false)

variables.name: Amazon Prime Gaming - Try to claim DLCs
variables.description: Try to claim DLCs (1 = true, 0 = false)

variables.name: GOG - Email
variables.description: The email address to use for logging in to GOG. Overrides default email.

variables.name: GOG - Password
variables.description: The password to use for logging in to GOG. Overrides default password.

variables.name: GOG - Keep newsletter subscription
variables.description: Keep the newsletter subscription (1 = true, 0 = false)

variables.name: Legacy Games - Email
variables.description: The email address to use for logging in to the Legacy Games. Overrides default email. Uses Prime Gaming email if not set.

variables.name: Notification service
variables.description: The Apprise notification service to use for notifications. See documentation for more details: https://github.com/vogler/free-games-claimer#notifications

variables.name: Notification title
variables.description: The title to use for notifications

variables.name: Enable VNC browser
variables.description: Enable browser. DO NOT CHANGE.

variables.name: VNC window width
variables.description: The width of the browser window

variables.name: VNC window height
variables.description: The height of the browser window

variables.name: VNC password
variables.description: The password for the VNC server

variables.name: VNC data profile
variables.description: Directory (inside Docker) for browser profile. DO NOT CHANGE.

variables.name: Timeout
variables.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the page to load

variables.name: Login timeout
variables.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the login page to load
